summaries.n-x-money: Coins routing creator fees to named X accounts through UsePaid, including e/acc, CALI and Elon Coin. Recipients now claim fees on-chain instead of receiving X Money payouts.
summaries.n-launchpad-coins: Coins for new launch tools, several copying UsePaid for other platforms. Most Solana tools such as insta.fan and XPAD have faded since launch week; WIRED on BNB Chain now carries most of the volume.

n-x-money.notice: UsePaid routes each coin's creator fees to the X account it's launched for. The fees are held for that X user to claim.
n-x-money.interpretation: The 2026-09-28 'payouts paused' banner is gone; the homepage lists recent on-chain claims by recipients and its last X Money transfer four days earlier. Claims are self-reported by the page, not independently verified.

n-pair-rewards.interpretation: Official KNOTS page still reports holder distributions in STONK (1,418,309 payouts, last six hours earlier); self-reported, not payout verification. Today's X search was refunded, so signals are carried over.
